name: poll-platform
description: PollWave — Real-Time Poll & Survey Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.clean: cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules dist && cd ../backend && rm -rf node_modules
